description: This file contains unit tests for the BufferParser component, which parses media buffers for audio and video streams, including handling encrypted content and various codec data. It uses Google Test framework and GStreamer for buffer management.

classes.name: BufferParserTests
classes.description: A Google Test fixture class for testing BufferParser functionality, setting up GStreamer buffers and sample data.

methods.name: buildSample
methods.description: Creates a GStreamer sample with the specified caps.

methods.name: buildBuffers
methods.description: Initializes GStreamer buffers with test data and attaches protection metadata.

methods.name: buildMapInfo
methods.description: Prepares GstMapInfo structure pointing to buffer data.
